canonical_Weyl_contract.convention: Tx=X, Ty=Z_m, Tx Ty=omega^(-m) Ty Tx
canonical_Weyl_contract.rotation: fixed Weil R with R X R^-1=Z_m, R Z_m R^-1=X^-1, R^4=I
canonical_Weyl_contract.fit_freedom: one complex Hermitian source/sink vector per hand and one shared real rho; charge-2 rows are fixed by the exact C4 channel map

free_commuting_comparator.favorable_bias: The free ranks consume all first-quadrant degree<=3 mixed points because four axis moments cannot identify rank-4/5 roots.

exact_gate.spatial_cover_bundle: unit-translation plaquette curvature must be zero at all 101 parent sites in both hands
exact_gate.claim_boundary: A nonzero-m survivor would be an effective projected-state representation, not literal deck holonomy.

decision_rule: A canonical Weyl model survives only when both its mixed gate and degree-4 heldout p values are >=0.01.
A free commuting comparator survives when its degree-4 heldout p value is >=0.01.
Weyl survival with commuting rank-5 failure is evidence for projective state algebra; survival of commuting rank-4/5 instead diagnoses prior rank<=3 insufficiency.
Failure of both excludes only these minimal forms, not a general rank-5 projective representation, Jordan sector, or image kernel.
